scripts.extension:build: npm run extension:build:chrome && npm run extension:build:firefox
scripts.extension:build:chrome: rm -rf packages/extension/dist-chrome && tsc -p packages/extension/tsconfig.json --outDir packages/extension/dist-chrome && cp packages/extension/manifest.chrome.json packages/extension/dist-chrome/manifest.json && cp packages/extension/popup.html packages/extension/dist-chrome/
scripts.extension:build:firefox: rm -rf packages/extension/dist-firefox && tsc -p packages/extension/tsconfig.json --outDir packages/extension/dist-firefox && cp packages/extension/manifest.firefox.json packages/extension/dist-firefox/manifest.json && cp packages/extension/popup.html packages/extension/dist-firefox/
scripts.extension:build:legacy: rm -rf packages/extension/dist && tsc -p packages/extension/tsconfig.json --outDir packages/extension/dist && cp packages/extension/manifest.chrome.json packages/extension/dist/manifest.json && cp packages/extension/popup.html packages/extension/dist/
